name: sidebar-header-vscode-exact
title: Sidebar header — duplicate VS Code look
description: Apply the confirmed VS Code header hyper-params on top of the whole-header model (7d4c219): fixed 22px header/line-height, 11px bold uppercase nowrap-ellipsis title (min-width 3ch), chevron-down glyph rotated -90deg when collapsed (+translateY(1px) when open) aria-hidden, first .sb-section no top border, .sb-section-actions margin-right 8px (keep always-visible + stopPropagation), non-collapsible title margin-left 8px, collapse animation retuned to 150ms ease-out with prefers-reduced-motion 0s, body stays in DOM. Header-overflow hidden so geometry is deterministic.
